info.title: Spare Me, Great Lord!
info.synopsis: Questa è la storia di un orfano, Lu Shu. Non è un orfano qualsiasi, ma un metaumano che affronta i cambiamenti in se stesso, nel suo paese e nel mondo all'alba dell'era magica. Lu Shu si imbarca in un viaggio per affinare le sue particolari abilità insieme a sua sorella, l'adorabile e carismatica Lu Xiaoyu. Lungo la strada, s'imbatteranno in eventi soprannaturali, ostacoli e persino nelle persone più potenti del loro paese. Come farà Lu Shu a sfruttare al meglio le sue capacità e a spodestare la sua infinita lista di rivali e avversari?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: In Lake City, a peaceful life is shattered by the resurgence of spiritual energy. After surviving a car accident, high school student Lu Shu unexpectedly awakens an ability: he grows stronger by harvesting "negative emotion points" from others. Although his younger sister, Lu Xiaoyu, is mischievous, the two rely on each other for survival. At school, Lu Shu dishes out cynical, snarky remarks to his classmates—garnering a massive amount of negative emotion points in the process—thereby revealing his unique method of leveling up and embarking on an extraordinary adventure in this new era.

episodes.synopsis: Lü Shu tests his system by deliberately annoying people. He spends his earned system points on a prize wheel, unlocking the "Fruit of Purification" and an infamous supernatural "Stinky Tofu" item.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The world begins acknowledging the "Aura Awakening." The mysterious organization Tian Luo Di Wang establishes special "Daoyuan Classes" in schools to train prospective metahumans. Lü Shu joins but hides his true power level.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Lü Shu's classmate, Liu Li, tries to show off his Class-F aptitude. Lü Shu mercilessly trolls him and his classmates to farm distress points, quickly realizing his internal cultivation speed vastly outpaces theirs.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
